title: Thandai
description: A creamy, chilled festival milk blended with almonds, melon seeds, fennel, poppy seeds, cardamom, pepper and saffron.

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.notes: soaked in warm water for 30 minutes

steps: Soak the almonds, cashews, watermelon seeds, fennel seeds, poppy seeds and rose petals in the 100 ml of warm water for 30 minutes.
Grind them with the cardamom and black pepper to a fine paste, adding a little of the water.
Warm 30 ml of the milk and dissolve the saffron in it.
Whisk the nut paste, saffron milk, sugar and the remaining cold milk together.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing the solids, and chill for an hour before serving.
